basic_info.description: Charming and Beautiful 2bd/2ba Condo offers exposed historic red brick, gorgeous wood floors, high ceilings and City/Bay Views in fantastic Nob Hill location on Powell at Clay. One Parking Space is included in Rent. The unit features remodeled kitchen with new cabinetry, wine cabinet, granite countertops, dishwasher, disposal, stove and refrigerator, renovated bathrooms. two bedrooms- one larger en-suite and one smaller bedroom, second full bathroom in hallway, large living room with Bay/City Views, three large windows with balconies and fireplace. Washer/Dryer in Unit.Centrally located....minutes to the Financial District, North Beach, Chinatown, Polk Street and Union Square! TRANSPORTATION: - Convenient public transportation and only minutes from Downtown SF and to the Financial District with the California Street Cable Car line or #1 California bus line. - Centrally located with nearby bus lines including: - # 1 bus on Sacramento St - # 27 bus on Hyde St - a few blocks away is the # 1, # 31, and the # 38 Geary bus line on Pine St as well as the # 47, # 49 and # 76 on Van Ness Avenue No SmokersWater & Garbage is included Shown by Appt.
